blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Croatia has opened 785 jobs to Filipinos following a government-to-government recruitment activity with the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). DMW Undersecretary Jainal T. Rasul Jr. and Croatian Employment Service (CES) Director General Ante Loncar signed the recruitment procedures on Monday and launched the recruitment activity for the hospitality industry. “Personal na lumahok ang siyam na hotel employers mula sa Croatia upang direktang makapanayam ang mga aplikante. Ang mga posisyon na bukas ay hotel staff, chef, waiters, at housekeeping,” the DMW said in a statement. (Nine hotel employers from Croatia participated in person to interview applicants directly.
